name: Spore Seed
text: A soft, dusty seed that smells of rain. Buried, it breathes out moss and mist, and mushrooms come up around it.

name: Glow Seed
text: A seed that glows faintly in your palm. Buried, it lights the ground around it with motes and glowing moss.

name: Bloom Seed
text: A plump seed striped like a petal. Buried, it wakes the flowers in the grass around it.

name: Verdure Seed
text: A green, eager seed. Buried, it thickens the grass and ferns around it.

name: Shimmer Seed
text: A seed with a crystal sheen. Buried, little crystals push up through the grass around it.

name: Spirit Seed
text: A pale seed that feels older than the forest. Buried, a quiet fae mist gathers around it, and old roots stir.
